title: Installed Standard publishes the original retired spool across roots and generations
question: Can a current Standard claim publish a retired complete spool held by an earlier runtime and generation without new provider work?
method: Interrupt installed execution after durable completion, verify writer retirement and missing publication, release sole demand interest, recover with an independent provider-start guard, and read back the original contributor on the new derivation.
commands: uv run python docs/design_review/evidence/2026-11-21_dmo-n47-recovery/installed-pdf-spool-control.py interrupt demands execute DEMAND_A --source-root python/corpus-structure/src --max-rounds 1 --json
uv run ci demands read DEMAND_A --view products --json
uv run ci demands cancel DEMAND_A --reason 'Controlled DMO stage test releases the sole interest after physical spool retirement' --json

uv run python docs/design_review/evidence/2026-11-21_dmo-n47-recovery/installed-pdf-spool-control.py no-provider demands execute DEMAND_B --source-root python/corpus-structure/src --max-rounds 1 --json
uv run ci demands read DEMAND_B --view products --json

outputs.role: Stage, runtime, receipt and independent writer/contributor observations

conclusion: The second runtime published from the generation 1 spool under a generation 2 claim. The contributor joined the new derivation to the original producer and exact manifest. The changed-original control produced a fresh publication and an in-memory change to the installed Docling factory refused at the same distribution version.
